'''Almera Zan''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agent sent to [[Demophon]] to find missing agent [[Enid Vahr]]. After her squad's starship was shot down over the planet, only Almera, [[Grashk]], [[Roz]], and their leader [[Tamarc]] survived. Tamarc was later killed by panicking [[Sla Kar]]. The Demophon mission was her first field mission, and she lacked confidence and was trigger happy as a result.<ref name="BE" />
